notes.content: [p][b]🗝️ Turn the key, share the chaos, and leave your mark[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hey workshop crew! We’d love to hear from you too—leave a comment on the PS Store or show off your trophies on social media with the tag [b]#A‑REDPS[/b].[/p]

notes.content:
A-RED Walking Robot looks like it could be an interesting puzzle-platformer. You control a wind-up robot toy, tasked with getting through a workshop full of different trials.

notes.title: A-RED Walking Robot Digital Polo Awards
notes.content:
Developed by JOOKITOOZ and distributed by Dojo System, it stands out for its inclusive approach and innovative accessible design. ✨

Our beloved A-RED Walking Robot, a masterpiece created by the talented Barcelona-based studio JOOKITOOZ, has been awarded the Best Accessible Video Game by Fundación ONCE at the 6th edition of the national Indie Games Málaga competition. 🏆 This prestigious recognition, presented during a gala at the Palacio de Ferias y Congresos de Málaga (FYCMA), comes with a financial prize of 4,000 euros. 💶

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748864/6662f7f0bde055d8dd47eaff49094f2eedf02316.jpg[/img]

The jury highlighted A-RED Walking Robot's outstanding commitment to accessibility, implementing features such as inclusive notifications 🔔, automatic camera positioning 🎥, automatic actions 🤖, and a clear tutorial with optimized key combinations 🕹️. These innovations allow players with disabilities to fully enjoy its unique proposal, based on precise physical mechanics ⚙️ and carefully designed challenges.

A-RED Walking Robot, a step toward inclusion and awareness in the industry
The game competed with three other equally remarkable finalists for their inclusive focus:

Camper Van: Make it Home, by Malapata Studios 🚐
Magical Bakery, by Superlumen 🧙‍♀️
MouseVentures, by FoundueGames 🐭
In addition to its technical merits, A-RED Walking Robot stands out for offering an experience that combines fun 🎮 and reflection 🤔, immersing players in a workshop full of surprises ✨, obstacles, and enemies that test both skill and strategy.

With this award, Fundación ONCE❤️ reinforces its goal of raising awareness and promoting inclusion in the video game industry, encouraging the development of titles that normalize and highlight disability from a positive perspective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44748864/346a05e71c0b1ee326f580afd1a9d023dedd2993.png[/img]

Discover now why A-RED Walking Robot is setting a milestone in accessibility and add it to your wishlist on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2659840/ARED_Walking_Robot/
